summary: ZTO Express (Cayman) Inc. filed a Form 6-K with Next Day Disclosure Returns under Hong Kong Listing Rules for daily share buybacks from May 20 to June 26, 2026. The issuer repurchased its own American depositary shares (each representing one Class A ordinary share) on-market at prices ranging from approximately USD 22.30 to USD 22.86 per ADS. These are open-market repurchases reducing shares outstanding, consistent with a capital return program. No recommendation or advisor is named. The filing is a routine HKSE disclosure; watch for cumulative buyback volume and use of any announced program authority.
